ethanol.name: Ethanol
ethanol.description: The most common sedative. A single use buys only a very short calm; an overdose presses down breathing, and stopping brings withdrawal.

nicotine.name: Nicotine
nicotine.summary: A short lift, then a quick drop.
nicotine.description: The stimulant in tobacco. One use gives a little action; too much brings palpitations and agitation.

arecoline.name: Arecoline
arecoline.summary: The stimulant alkaloid in betel nut.
arecoline.description: One use gives a little action; too much slides into cholinergic overload and agitation.

caffeine.name: Caffeine
caffeine.description: One use buys 1 action point; too much brings palpitations and anxiety, then tolerance and withdrawal.

magnesium_threonate.name: Magnesium L-threonate
magnesium_threonate.summary: Left-Su: part of the anti-dissociation and recovery kit.
magnesium_threonate.description: One use clears a little dissociation and lets glutamate fall back toward baseline. Repeated use does not trigger extra effects.

diphenhydramine.name: Diphenhydramine
diphenhydramine.description: One use helps you sleep and holds down some agitation; too much brings anticholinergic effects and clouded consciousness.

dimenhydrinate.name: Dimenhydrinate
dimenhydrinate.description: One use holds down nausea and agitation; too much brings delirium and anticholinergic effects.

omeprazole.name: Omeprazole
omeprazole.description: One use makes the body a little more comfortable; it does not touch the mind directly, but it slows the metabolism of some drugs.

melatonin.name: Melatonin
melatonin.description: One use helps you sleep and restores a little psyche; too much just makes you sleepier.

amantadine.name: Amantadine
amantadine.summary: Antiviral and antiparkinson drug; delirium in overdose.
amantadine.description: One use gives a little action; too much brings anticholinergic effects and delirium.

memantine.name: Memantine
memantine.summary: NMDA antagonist; misused as a dissociative.
memantine.description: One use lets glutamate fall and clears a little dissociation; too much brings dissociation and delirium.

nefopam.name: Nefopam
nefopam.summary: Non-opioid analgesic with anticholinergic side effects.
nefopam.description: One use eases physical pain; too much brings anticholinergic effects and agitation.

fluoxetine.name: Fluoxetine
fluoxetine.summary: One of the five golden flowers; a long-acting SSRI.
fluoxetine.description: One use starts an SSRI course; too much pushes serotonin past the threshold. It also inhibits CYP2D6.

sertraline.name: Sertraline
sertraline.summary: One of the five golden flowers.
sertraline.description: One use starts an SSRI course; too much pushes serotonin past the threshold.

paroxetine.name: Paroxetine
paroxetine.summary: One of the five golden flowers; marked discontinuation effects.
paroxetine.description: One use starts an SSRI course; too much pushes serotonin past the threshold.

fluvoxamine.name: Fluvoxamine
fluvoxamine.summary: One of the five golden flowers; broad CYP inhibition.
fluvoxamine.description: One use starts an SSRI course; too much pushes serotonin past the threshold.

citalopram.name: Citalopram
citalopram.summary: One of the five golden flowers.
citalopram.description: One use starts an SSRI course; too much pushes serotonin past the threshold.

venlafaxine.name: Venlafaxine
venlafaxine.description: One use starts an SNRI course; too much pushes serotonin and noradrenaline up together.

duloxetine.name: Duloxetine
duloxetine.summary: SNRI; also used for nerve pain.
duloxetine.description: One use starts an SNRI course; too much pushes serotonin and noradrenaline up together.

bupropion.name: Bupropion
bupropion.summary: NDRI antidepressant with a stimulant edge.
bupropion.description: One use gives a little action and psyche; too much brings agitation and palpitations.

quetiapine.name: Quetiapine
quetiapine.summary: Atypical antipsychotic; low doses are often used for sleep.
quetiapine.description: One use holds down delirium and agitation; too much brings sedation and anticholinergic effects.

naloxone.name: Naloxone
naloxone.description: One use clears respiratory depression and pulls endorphins back; repeated use does not trigger extra effects.

flumazenil.name: Flumazenil
flumazenil.description: One use clears sedation; repeated use does not trigger extra effects.

trihexyphenidyl.name: Trihexyphenidyl
trihexyphenidyl.description: One use eases physical stiffness; too much brings delirium and anticholinergic effects.

promethazine.name: Promethazine
promethazine.description: One use holds down agitation; too much brings anticholinergic effects and delirium.

tramadol.name: Tramadol
tramadol.summary: Weak opioid analgesic that also touches serotonin and noradrenaline.
tramadol.description: One use eases physical pain; too much depresses breathing and pushes serotonin up.

mirtazapine.name: Mirtazapine
mirtazapine.description: One use restores psyche and sleep; too much brings sedation and metabolic load.

trazodone.name: Trazodone
trazodone.summary: Antidepressant, low doses often used for sleep.
trazodone.description: One use helps you sleep; too much brings sedation and a serotonin load.

gabapentin.name: Gabapentin
gabapentin.description: One use lowers anxiety; too much sedates.

olanzapine.name: Olanzapine
olanzapine.description: One use holds down agitation and delirium; too much brings sedation and anticholinergic effects.

haloperidol.name: Haloperidol
haloperidol.description: One use holds down delirium; too much brings sedation and extrapyramidal load.

scopolamine.name: Scopolamine
scopolamine.description: One use eases nausea and motion sickness; too much brings delirium and anticholinergic effects.

lithium.name: Lithium carbonate
lithium.summary: Mood stabiliser with a very narrow window.
lithium.description: One use steadies the psyche; too much brings toxicity, delirium and physical damage.

dextromethorphan.name: Dextromethorphan
dextromethorphan.summary: Cough suppressant; a dissociative at high doses.
dextromethorphan.description: One use lets glutamate fall; too much brings heavy dissociation, and it turns on itself.

pregabalin.name: Pregabalin
pregabalin.summary: Antiepileptic and anxiolytic; stopping hits hard.
pregabalin.description: One use holds down agitation; too much brings sedation and respiratory depression.

alprazolam.name: Alprazolam
alprazolam.description: One use holds down agitation; too much brings sedation and respiratory depression.

clonazepam.name: Clonazepam
clonazepam.description: One use holds down agitation; too much brings sedation and respiratory depression.

zolpidem.name: Zolpidem
zolpidem.summary: Hypnotic; vivid dreams and sleepwalking are commonly reported.
zolpidem.description: One use helps you sleep; too much brings sedation and delirium.

esketamine.name: Esketamine
esketamine.summary: Dissociative; recently used for treatment-resistant depression.
esketamine.description: One use brings brief dissociation and restores psyche; too much brings heavy dissociation and a backlash.

ketamine.name: Ketamine
ketamine.description: One use brings brief dissociation; too much brings heavy dissociation and a psychic backlash.

diazepam.name: Diazepam
diazepam.description: One use holds down agitation; too much brings sedation and respiratory depression.

lorazepam.name: Lorazepam
lorazepam.description: One use holds down agitation; too much brings sedation and respiratory depression.

zopiclone.name: Eszopiclone
zopiclone.description: One use helps you sleep; too much brings sedation and delirium.

methylphenidate.name: Methylphenidate
methylphenidate.description: One use gives 1 action point; too much brings agitation and palpitations.

modafinil.name: Modafinil
modafinil.description: One use gives 1 action point; too much brings agitation and insomnia.

dihydrocodeine.name: Dihydrocodeine
dihydrocodeine.summary: Weak opioid analgesic and cough suppressant.
dihydrocodeine.description: One use eases physical pain; too much depresses breathing.

morphine.name: Morphine
morphine.description: One use holds down pain; too much depresses breathing.

codeine.name: Codeine
codeine.description: One use holds down pain; too much depresses breathing.

fentanyl.name: Fentanyl
fentanyl.description: One use holds down pain; too much depresses breathing fast.

methadone.name: Methadone
methadone.description: One use holds down pain and withdrawal; too much depresses breathing.

breathe.name: Breathe
breathe.description: Put your attention back on your breathing.

window.name: Look out the window
window.description: Confirm the same tree is still out there.

ask.name: Ask yourself
ask.description: Ask yourself: is this a persecutory delusion?

message.name: Message a friend
message.description: Send this moment to a real person.
